synthesizedFacts.fact: Glabellar lines, also known as frown lines or '11 lines', are vertical wrinkles that form between the eyebrows due to repeated facial expressions and aging.
The formation of glabellar lines is influenced by factors such as aging, loss of collagen, repeated muscle movements, and lifestyle choices like sun exposure and smoking.
Non-invasive treatments such as Botox, dermal fillers, and laser resurfacing are effective in reducing the appearance of glabellar lines.
Moisturizing and antioxidant creams can help in maintaining skin resilience and reducing the appearance of fine lines.
